title: Riglane Workflow Manifest
description: Schema for manifest.json files. The manifest is the workflow's runtime state — created at workflow_init, updated as steps progress, finalized at workflow end.

$schema.description: Optional reference to this JSON Schema for editor tooling.

workflow_version.description: Workflow version copied from workflow.yaml at workflow_init.

run_id.description: Unique run identifier. Format: <workflow-name>-<YYYYMMDD-HHmmss>-<4hex>. Same value as the trace's run_id.

run_token.description: UUID4 for run verification. Regenerated at every workflow_init. The orchestrator injects this into subagent prompts as <!--workflow:run_token:UUID-->. the riglane gate-check hook uses it to detect stale gate results from prior runs/sessions.

params.description: Resolved workflow parameters. Includes user-supplied values, defaults, the engine-injected synthetic 'run_id' param, and any param_bindings updates applied during execution.

current_step.description: Name of the step currently executing or last executed. NULL only when there are no steps.

started_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp with timezone offset. When this run started.

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp. MUST be updated on every state change. Used by find_workflow_dir to detect the active workflow.

steps.description: Per-step state. Keys are step names (matching workflow.yaml). All workflow steps MUST have an entry, initialized at workflow_init with status='pending'.

completed_at.description: Set by workflow_finalize when the run terminates.

model_override.description: Run-level model override (--model at launch / riglane ui / a launcher app, the model_override arg to workflow_init, or RIGLANE_MODEL_OVERRIDE env). Overrides each step's per-step model MODE for all subagent steps of this run. Validated at workflow_init.

step_tools.description: Frozen per-step tool declarations (step-tool-rights): computed once at workflow_init (backfilled at workflow_resume) for the whole step tree, route and inline steps included. The call-time declaration guard reads THIS copy, never the live workflow.yaml — a mid-run tools: edit cannot change a running run's rights. A step declaring nothing carries []; absence of the whole field means the manifest predates the freeze (guard applies upgrade grace).

name.description: script: combined MCP core name <wfNorm>__<toolNorm>; mcp: raw expected tool name; spec: engine tool name.

server.description: mcp only: the declared server name (raw).

parallel_branches.description: Set by step_begin for parallel steps; deleted by step_complete after merge. Keys are branch indices as strings.

resolved_outputs.description: Persist-once (parallel-output-paths): per-branch output paths resolved once at step_begin so merge + gate read them verbatim (write/validate agree by construction). One entry per declared output. Absent on legacy runs.

first_started_at.description: Initial step start. Immutable across retries (set only if absent on subsequent step_begin calls).

duration_ms.description: Step duration in milliseconds. Computed by step_complete as (completed_at - started_at) * 1000.

prompt_files.description: Per-branch prompt file paths for parallel steps.

tool_warnings.description: Diagnostic warnings about declared-but-uncalled tools. Emitted by step_complete when a step's tools whitelist was not fully exercised.

gate_results.description: Results from each gate layer. Layers report independently. A layer that did not run MAY be omitted.

summary.description: Brief description of what this step did. Used by context.carry_forward='summary'.

parallel_tasks.description: Per-branch state for steps with parallel: true.
